about: The sandbox allowlist for real runs. The updater writes only to a project listed here, on the Jira site whose fingerprint is given. A site fingerprint is the first 16 characters of the SHA-256 of the site's address, so the address itself is not stored. Entries are added by a person.

sandbox_projects.note: SCRUM, the participant's sandbox project. Added on 2026-11-19 after the participant confirmed it is a sandbox they may change.
